typography.note: CLAUDE.md describes Newsreader/Cormorant + Instrument Sans, but the implemented CSS uses Montserrat everywhere. Trust the CSS.

radius.note: Deliberately square. CLAUDE.md's 'no sharp 0px radius' rule is outdated; the shipped design is fully squared.

motion.pattern: data-reveal / data-reveal-group scroll reveals driven by client/js/motion.js

must: Plain HTML/CSS/JS only — no React, no JSX, no Tailwind, no build step on the client
Style with existing CSS custom properties from client/css/style.css, not new hard-coded hex values
Bump the ?v= query on the style.css <link> in every page when style.css changes (cache busting)
Responsive down to mobile — Pakistan is a mobile-heavy market
Visible keyboard focus states on all interactive elements
Prices in PKR formatted as Rs 1,450
avoid: Rounded corners — the shipped design is squared (radius tokens are 0)
Pink/plum 'Soft Tea' palette from CLAUDE.md — the live brand is forest green
Supplier marketing images with baked-in headline text or competitor watermarks as hero/tile art
Decorative gradients, glassmorphism, and oversized display headlines

decisions.decision: Category tiles use curated /assets/hero photography, not product marketing graphics. The 5/4 tile crop cuts through baked-in supplier text.
